# Python dependencies for .github/scripts.
#
# cmd.py loads generate-prdoc.py at import time to register its subcommand, so every
# command it offers -- bench included -- needs the prdoc dependencies present or the
# script dies before it parses its own arguments. The workflows install these ad hoc
# in three different places; this file is so a machine running the tooling by hand can
# get the same set.
